audit_type: Independent read-only editorial evidence, identity and preservation check
scope: This audit checks the truth and identity of the consolidated editorial proof against original batch reports, current language article objects, final shared-metadata reports and preserved original baseline. It is not another reading of 340 essays. The audit itself made no protected-file changes, did not run prepare/render or issue a publication seal, and did not commit. A separate genuine seal was produced by the lead; this new unprotected report records the completed read-only proof checks.

checks.result: The canonical cross-review-de-fr, cross-review-ja-ko and cross-review-es reports cover exactly the 340 distinct language/slug identities. Every canonical and individual reading record refers to the correct original batch filename. All five individual reports contain exactly68reading records and68current hashes.

checks.item: Read-time identity kept, not overwritten by final state
checks.result: For every original batch record, the original article_sha256 or reading_time_article_sha256 key and value are preserved in both its individual language report and canonical report. In particular32French records retain their reading_time_article_sha256 key. Current corrected hashes are stored separately, not substituted for the historically read version.

Every original batch current_batch_article_sha256 entry and every individual current_article_sha256 entry matches the corresponding current saved article object. Across all five languages there are no missing slugs, duplicate reading identities, mismatches or stale current hashes.

All361accepted after strings from the three canonical reports are present in the actual corresponding current fields. This is a replacement/identity check, not another semantic evaluation or a claim to have reread every surrounding essay in this audit.

The split original batch provenance remains available and accords with the actual assignments: lead independently read DE/JA and ESguide–58; reviewer B independently read FRincluding lead/A/C-authored ranges; reviewer A independently read KOguide–10, lead read KO11–67; reviewer C independently read lead-authored ES59–67. Final metadata is independently assigned C forDE/ES,B forFR,A forJA/KO. Consolidation does not falsely label a single person as having independently read their own whole-language manuscript.

All ten current series/UI objects and156complete fields in the three final metadata reports match the current language files. Field values and hashes were checked, including all group, label and route-note list contents, without replacing the independent actual-reading records already recorded there.

The French final metadata report intentionally preserves the original series.scope field value and original series-object SHA from its actual initial reading. Its post_application and current_objects separately identify the saved revised scope and new current series SHA. Verification used that explicit post-read override rather than incorrectly demanding the historical scope hash equal the current value.

All204canonical reading Markdown files,68canonical source digests,68original multilingual body hashes,69original primary-main hashes,the canonical manifest and two distinct legacy page byte hashes match primary-before-expansion.json. Baseline commit is31c627b79436bc81381a6f23b2ad4258a3274913.

Read scripts/test_zhuangzi_languages.py without executing its positive checks. It requires genuine approvals/seal, preserved original bodies/main/source files, actual quoted body/apparatus/source URLs,native non-linear index groups,metadata/citations/language links/analytics/IDs/local fragments,negative corruptions and discovery/search/sitemap. This audit did not render or prepare merely to exercise those tests.

hash_algorithms.article_and_complete_series_ui_objects: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True) with Python default separators, including spaces. These stable object hashes are used by the original article/current-map and final shared-object identity checks.
hash_algorithms.de_es_final_metadata_string_fields: SHA256 of the raw UTF-8 string; arrays/objects use the same sorted JSON serialization with default separators.
hash_algorithms.ja_ko_fr_final_metadata_fields: SHA256 of UTF-8 sorted JSON serialization of the value, including quotation marks for string values. The JSON-value convention, not the raw-string convention, was verified for all these fields.
hash_algorithms.file_hashes: SHA256 of actual current file bytes. Current file SHAs below identify evidence checked, not a newly manufactured approval or receipt.

limitations: No new complete prose reading of340essays was performed or claimed in this proof audit.
This does not independently certify mother-tongue identity, native-human proofreading, literary quality or the truth of every historical interpretation.
Existing actual article readings, source adjudications and full saved-field post-application records retain their own original scopes and dates.
No protected report, manuscript, source, page, profile or seal was edited; only this new unprotected proof report was created.
